briefs.claim_en: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, leading to an increase in COVID-19 cases in areas where 5G was installed.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources, including AP News, UN News, and the National Center for Biotechnology Information, state that there is no scientific evidence to support a link between 5G technology and the spread of COVID-19. They explain that COVID-19 is a viral disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus and spreads through respiratory droplets, not radio waves or mobile networks. Several fact-checking organizations like AFP Fact Check, Full Fact, and Alt News, published between March 2020 and May 2021, have rated claims linking 5G to the coronavirus as false. These sources also note that conspiracy theories about 5G and COVID-19 have led to incidents such as the burning of cell towers in the UK and other European countries.
